question: How is the Nandikā measured in relation to half and sixth parts?
premises: The Nandikā is the subject of measurement.
A sixth part is included in the measure.
inference: The Nandikā is measured as a half part together with a sixth part.
uncertainties: Exact referent of the base being divided
plain_english: O lady, the Nandikā is measured as a half part together with a sixth part.
